basics.summary: I’m Elroy, a 23-year-old guy on a journey of self-discovery through the exciting worlds of IT and engineering. Currently calling Singapore home, I’m taking a detour from the typical academic path to explore and develop myself before diving into SUTD for a degree.

work.name: BasedApp
highlights: Engineered a TypeScript MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration with the Hyperliquid API to query public databases and validate on-chain transactions, cutting manual debugging time for user inquiries.
Led the migration to Intercom, designing automated workflows and AI-triage agents supporting 12,000+ monthly active users and personally resolving 470+ technical incidents a month.
Managed Discord community security (grew 4,000 to 6,000+ members): deployed anti-phishing bots, audited role permissions, and ran scam incident response.
Authored the "Community Response Playbook" and maintained the official GitBook docs as the single source of truth for the support team.

Built an internal Telegram + Hyperliquid MCP server (Node.js, TypeScript) with chat allow-listing and secure session management, enabling AI agents to query on-chain positions/order history within API rate limits (1,200 weight/min).

work.name: Singapore Army
highlights: Managed TALC (TRADOC Admin and Logistic Center) logistic stores: procurement and maintaining essential stock levels and supplies.
Volunteered 3+ weeks on attachment to ATEC for Exercise Wallaby (XWB) 2024; awarded the ATEC commander's coin for outstanding service.

work.name: Singapore Polytechnic
highlights: Led a team of 3 to build an automated mushroom-farming system, integrating hardware sensors with software monitoring.
Owned the hardware design and integrated the software into the system.
